phases.name: Establish technique and baseline
phases.run_note: Session 2: 15–18 min easy run/walk. Session 5: 20–30 min easy if tolerated.
phases.notes: First 2 weeks: 2 working sets per lift. Then main lifts to 3 sets if recovery is good; accessories stay at 2. Controlled low jumps, light rotations, no max efforts.

phases.name: Build muscle and aerobic capacity
phases.run_note: 4 × 1 min hard / 1 min easy inside an 18-min run; optional easy run builds toward 30–35 min.
phases.notes: Main lifts 3 × 6–8; other lifts 2–3 sets at listed ranges. Finish with 2–3 reps left. Increase speed on power work while retaining control.

phases.name: Build strength
phases.run_note: Work toward the full 6-interval run. Optional easy run 30–40 min.
phases.notes: Reference doses: trap bar 4 × 4–5, front squat 4 × 4–6, other lifts as listed. Crisp jumps, light fast rotations.

phases.name: Consolidate strength
phases.run_note: Hold intervals steady. Optional easy run up to 40–45 min if comfortable.
phases.notes: Continue reference doses. Increase load only when earned; 3 main-lift sets if golf or fatigue rises. No max testing.

phases.name: Emphasize golf power
phases.run_note: Session 2: 4–6 intervals only if legs feel fresh; otherwise easy running. Optional easy run 25–40 min. More golf practice.
phases.notes: Main lifts 2–3 × 3–5. Accessories 2 sets; omit Session 3's optional accessory and Session 4 lunges when needed. Power: 3 sets of 3–4 reps, swings 6.

phases.name: Arrive fresh
phases.run_note: Replace hard intervals with 15–20 min easy running. Optional cardio 20–30 min. Scoring practice and simulated rounds.
phases.notes: Sets down 30–40 %: 2 per main lift, 1–2 per accessory. Familiar loads only. Power 2–3 × 2–3; swings 2 × 5. No new drills.

phases.name: In-season maintenance
phases.run_note: Four sessions of 20–50 min; optional fifth is easy recovery only.
phases.notes: Two short strength sessions weekly (2 × 3–5 main, 1–2 accessory sets). One short power session; fourth session is easy cardio and mobility.

S1.title: Lower-body strength, back and core
S1.budget: 8 warm-up · 6 jumps · 18 main lift · 23 accessories · 10 core · 5 transitions
warmup: Easy walk, bike or jog — 2 min

exercises.name: Box jump
exercises.notes: Modest box; land quietly and step down

exercises.name: Trap-bar deadlift
exercises.notes: Brace; ~2 reps in reserve. 2–4 build-up sets first

S2.title: Rotational power, upper body and run
S2.budget: 7 warm-up · 15 power · 25 upper body · 18 running · 5 transitions
warmup: Hip switches, thoracic rotations, wall slides
A few light practice reps of today's cable or landmine movement

exercises.name: Broad jump
exercises.notes: Reset between reps; stick each landing

A.name: Explosive cable rotation
A.notes: Chest height; hips → torso → arms; decelerate before the end

B.name: Landmine rotation
B.notes: Hips → torso → arms; no jerking the plate

exercises.name: Pull-up or lat pulldown
exercises.notes: Add weight only when bodyweight reps stay clean

run.structure: 3 min easy · 6 × (1 min hard @ RPE 7–8 + 1 min easy) · 3 min easy

S3.title: Full-body strength and trunk control
S3.budget: 8 warm-up · 5 jumps · 17 squat · 25 accessories · 10 core · 5 transitions
warmup: Easy walk, bike or jog — 2 min
A few unloaded hinges before lifting

exercises.name: Front squat
exercises.notes: Goblet squat is an alternative. 2–4 build-up sets first

exercises.name: Romanian deadlift
exercises.notes: Hinge through the hips; controlled lowering

A.name: Reverse lunge
A.notes: First to omit if time runs short

B.name: Back extension
B.notes: Finish straight; don't arch past neutral

S4.title: Power and athleticism
S4.budget: 10 warm-up · 25 power · 20 athletic strength · 5 carries · 5 transitions
warmup: Daily mobility sequence at a comfortable pace (shorten drills to fit)
Light rehearsal sets of the first power movements

B.name: Lateral bound
B.notes: Stabilise each landing before the next rep

exercises.name: Walking DB lunge
exercises.notes: Omit if Thursday still affects your movement

four_session_variant.budget: 10 warm-up · 20 power · 12 strength · 18 easy run · 5 transitions

run.structure: conversational pace, easy start and finish

S5.title: Easy aerobic work and mobility (optional)

run.structure: 30–45 min conversational; bike, elliptical or incline walk when impact would interfere with golf
